About Us

Discover the story, values, and passion behind every handmade candle we create.

Our Story

Luminous Flame was born from a simple love of candlelight and the desire to create something meaningful with our own hands. In 2018, founder Maya Chen started making candles in her small Portland kitchen, experimenting with natural waxes, essential oils, and sustainable practices. What began as a passion project quickly grew into a full-fledged business when friends and family fell in love with the quality and care poured into each hand-poured candle.

Today, we remain committed to the artisanal approach that started it all. Every candle is still made by hand in small batches, using only the finest natural ingredients. We believe that the ritual of lighting a candle should be a moment of peace and joy—and that begins with knowing exactly what goes into the product you bring into your home.

Our Values

Quality Craftsmanship

Every candle is hand-poured with meticulous attention to detail. We reject mass production in favor of mindful creation, ensuring each piece meets our high standards.

Natural Ingredients

We use premium soy wax, pure essential oils, and sustainable materials. No synthetic fragrances, no harmful chemicals—just the finest nature has to offer.

Environmental Responsibility

Our packaging is recyclable and compostable. We work with suppliers who share our commitment to sustainability and reducing our environmental footprint.

Community Connection

We partner with local artisans and suppliers whenever possible, supporting our Portland community and building relationships built on trust and shared values.

Our Process

Handcrafting a candle is both an art and a science. Here's how we create each Luminous Flame candle:

  1. Sourcing: We carefully select premium soy wax and source essential oils from trusted suppliers who prioritize quality and sustainability.
  2. Blending: Our scent masters blend custom fragrance combinations, testing each blend for balance and longevity.
  3. Pouring: Wax is gently heated to the perfect temperature and hand-poured into vessels. This slow process ensures optimal wick placement and even burning.
  4. Curing: Each candle cures for 48 hours, allowing the wax and scent to fully integrate for a superior burn experience.
  5. Quality Check: Before packaging, every candle is inspected for consistency, appearance, and scent integrity.
  6. Finishing: Each candle is lovingly packaged with our signature label and care instructions, ready to brighten someone's day.

Meet Maya Chen, Founder

"I've always believed that the objects we surround ourselves with should tell a story. When I started making candles, I wasn't just creating a product—I was creating moments of calm and connection. Every time someone lights a Luminous Flame candle, I hope they feel the intention and love we've poured into it."

Maya holds a degree in sustainable design from Portland State University and has studied traditional candle-making techniques from makers around the world. When she's not in the studio, you'll find her hiking in the Cascades, experimenting with new scent combinations, or mentoring young artisans in the community.
